title: fix(showcase): mount the Recalculate Estimate api endpoint
body:
Follow-up to the [#2169](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/2169) / [#2171](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/2171) action audit. While reviewing the showcase task actions I found a live #2169 **sibling**:

## Problem

`showcase_recalc_estimate` is a `type: 'api'` action whose `target` is `/api/v1/showcase/recalc` — but **no such route was ever registered**, so clicking "Recalculate Estimate" 404'd. The schema guard from #2171 can't catch this: an `api` action only needs a target *string*, and an arbitrary HTTP endpoint's existence isn't statically verifiable (flow/modal targets get cross-ref validation; raw URLs don't).

## Fix

Mount the route imperatively against the `http.server` service in `onEnable`, on the `kernel:ready` hook — the service is available by then, and Hono's route matcher only freezes later on `kernel:listening`, so the route lands in time. It recomputes `estimate_hours` from the schedule window (working at 8h/day) and persists it; the action's `refreshAfter: true` repaints the value. Adds a `successMessage` and unit coverage.

## Verification

- **Live server, end-to-end:** `POST /api/v1/showcase/recalc` → HTTP 200; `estimate_hours` went 40 → 136 for a 17-day window (16-Jun → 02-Jul, inclusive × 8h), persisted.
- Endpoint mount probe: unauthenticated `POST` with no body → `400 {recordId required}` (route reached, not a 404 passthrough).
- `pnpm verify` (app-showcase): typecheck + **30 tests** (incl. 4 new `recalc-endpoint` tests).

## Not included (deliberately)

Two related issues I found root-cause to the **built console renderer** (objectui), not framework metadata, so they're out of scope here and need an objectui change + vendored-console bump:

- **"Mark Done shows on already-done records"** — gating the action with `visible` is not honored for record-header actions in the shipped console (any record-field predicate hides the button entirely), so a metadata-only fix would make it worse. Needs the renderer to evaluate header-action `visible` with record context.
- **"Log Time does nothing"** — objectui's `ActionRunner` has no `case 'form'`, so `type: 'form'` actions fall through and no-op. Needs a `form` handler in the renderer.
